risks: We’ve reached several key development milestones and are now preparing for the next phase. Here is an overview of how we are managing potential risks: 1. Mass Production Development, tooling, and pilot production are fully complete. Mass production is scheduled for December 2026, with quality and timelines being closely monitored to minimize potential delays. 2. Logistics & Fulfillment Shipping is slated to begin in January 2027. While our established logistics network supports worldwide delivery, please note that customs clearance and regional shipping conditions may impact timelines. 3. Global Compliance We are currently finalizing the required certifications for our target markets. Please be aware that regulatory approvals may affect product availability or delivery schedules in certain regions. 4. Our Commitment We remain committed to sharing regular progress updates and communicating openly about any challenges or changes to our plans.

faq.q: How are shipping fees and taxes calculated?
faq.a: Shipping fees vary by destination and will be shown at checkout. Any applicable taxes or import duties will depend on local regulations and the final shipping arrangements.

Shipping is expected to begin in January 2027, following mass production in December 2026.
Delivery times may vary by region. We'll share shipping updates and tracking details as your reward gets ready to ship.

RheoFit A1 Lite: 12-month limited warranty

Accessories: 6-month limited warranty

Coverage includes manufacturing defects and hardware or firmware malfunctions under normal use. Accidental damage, unauthorized modifications, and normal wear and tear are excluded.

For more detailed support, contact service@rheofit.com.

faq.q: Can I cancel my pledge or request a refund?
faq.a:
You can cancel your pledge through Kickstarter before the campaign ends, subject to Kickstarter's cancellation rules. 

After the campaign ends, refund requests will be handled in accordance with our published refund policy. For assistance, please contact service@rheofit.com.
